93 workers missing after Nepal tunnel incident, search continues

Ninety-three workers remain unaccounted for following an incident at the Rasuwagadhi hydropower tunnel in Nepal. Searches conducted inside the tunnel have not located any individuals. A thermal drone deployed to aid the search also yielded no results. The status of the missing workers is currently unknown.
